completeness.reason: Every obligation is engaged but at a shallow level within the element's own text: the accuracy and cadence parents are covered only by 'measures the voltage of up to 16 series cells per module' - no error bound, no voltage span, no conversion interval - those numbers sit in the supplier specifications rather than here. The open-wire parent's second half is not covered at all: the element 'runs the open-wire diagnosis' but says nothing about the cell's voltage being reported invalid rather than as a measured value, which is the externally visible half of REQ_OPEN_WIRE_DETECTION.
completeness.suggestion: Carry the committed figures into the element (accuracy, voltage span, conversion interval, open-wire flag latency) with a pointer to the supplier specifications, and state the invalid-value contract: what the front end puts on the daisy-chain link for a faulted input, so the 'reported as invalid, not as a value' obligation is visible at this level.

consistency.reason: Sole element on both of its parents, so there is no same-parent sibling to contradict. It also sits compatibly beside ARCH_CELL_MEASUREMENT_ACQ in the cell-protection stream: that element owns the cyclic software readout from the daisy-chained front-end devices, while this one is the device chain itself, so the two are complementary rather than overlapping.

design_clarity.reason: Names a concrete choice, not a goal: a bought front end covering up to 16 series cells per module, per-input open-wire diagnosis, results carried over an isolated daisy-chain link, with its behaviour pinned by this stream's supplier specifications (SUP_AFE_MEASUREMENT_ACCURACY and SUP_AFE_OPEN_WIRE_DIAGNOSIS fix the 1.5 mV over -40 degC to 105 degC, 5 ms conversion and 50 ms flag). The partition and interface are decisions, and the numbers live one hop downstream by design.

implementability.reason: A single, clearly bounded bought component: 16 cells per module, one isolated daisy-chain interface, per-input diagnosis, and behaviour fixed by named supplier specifications - realisable without further design judgement at the specification level.

parent_fit.reason: Addresses both parents substantively and at the right boundary: it is the acquisition element that measures every cell voltage (REQ_CELL_VOLTAGE_ACCURACY) and the element that diagnoses a broken sense input (REQ_OPEN_WIRE_DETECTION), and it correctly leaves the invalid-value and protection reactions to the consumers.

summary: The cleanest of the three architecture elements: one bounded bought part, a stated interface and supplier specifications pinning the numbers. Its only real shortfall is that the accuracy/cadence obligations are delegated rather than restated, and the invalid-value half of the open-wire requirement is not addressed inside the element. 9/10.
